run_inference_benchmark: run an inference benchmark on a detection model using a config file and checkpoint
run_dataloader_benchmark: run a dataloader benchmark to measure data loading speed for a detection dataset
run_dataset_benchmark: run a dataset benchmark to measure dataset preparation speed for detection tasks
run_benchmark_with_options: run a benchmark with custom config options, warmup iterations, and logging interval
run_distributed_benchmark: run a distributed benchmark using pytorch or slurm launcher across multiple GPUs
